clauses.title: Personal Property
clauses.text: We cover your personal property against the perils named in this policy up to the limit stated in the Declarations.

clauses.title: Personal Liability
clauses.text: We pay on your behalf damages you become legally obligated to pay for bodily injury or property damage caused by an occurrence, up to the liability limit in the Declarations.

clauses.title: Replacement Cost Loss Settlement
clauses.text: Personal property losses are settled at replacement cost, subject to the policy limit and deductible.

clauses.title: Exclusion – Motor Vehicles
clauses.text: Motor vehicles and their parts are not covered.

clauses.title: Exclusion – Flood and Earthquake
clauses.text: We do not cover loss caused by flood, earthquake or earth movement.

clauses.title: Exclusion – Business Property
clauses.text: Property used in a business is not covered.

clauses.title: Exclusion – Jewelry, Watches, Furs and Precious Stones
clauses.text: This policy does not cover jewelry, watches, furs or precious or semi-precious stones for any cause of loss. Coverage for these items may be available by separate scheduled endorsement, which is not included in this quote.
